utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve still not heard any fresh updates, but I’m asking around now and I’ll pass along anything I learn.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep passing the word around too, and we’ll make sure everyone knows to meet at the community center at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks — I’ll spread the word about the 9 a.m. meet-up at the community center too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing — send me the repair drive plan and pickup spots when you have them, and I’ll stick to that.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — after 3:30 works for me too. Do we still need screws, paint brushes, or drop cloths?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please—screws, paint brushes, and drop cloths would all be helpful. I’ll follow the plan once you send the pickup spots.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Those basics are still the most useful—screwdrivers, pliers, wrenches, tape, plus any extra nails or screws you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I can ask around for those. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Late morning works best for me—around 10, if that suits you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard they’re looking for tools, a few extra hands, and people who can handle a loose hinge or fence patch. If you can get the list, I can help figure out what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll grab the list and keep it simple and direct, then we can sort out what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — send it my way when you have it, and I’ll help sort through what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll help sort the donations and carry boxes over to the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey — that’s a huge help. If you can sort the donations and carry the boxes over to the hall, we’ll be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll get started on sorting them and take the boxes over to the hall.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — thanks, Cleo! Can you meet us at the community center at 9 a.m.? I’ll make sure you’re on the invite list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — 9 a.m. at the community center works for me. I’ll be there with the supply list and anything we still need to pick up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Cleo — thanks! I’ll add you to the invite list and see you at the community center at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still don’t have the repair drive details in front of me, Dane, but I can help piece them together from what we know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal — let’s piece it together. If you remember anything else, I’ll help organize the volunteers and tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — I’ll do the same and share anything I remember as soon as it comes back to me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details one more time? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’ll bring the cordless drill, the spare screws, and a box for the small parts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — that’s helpful. Can you also send the pickup spots and plan when you have them, so I can make sure I’ve got everything right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep things simple today—just tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli — just pass the word along that it’s this Saturday at 9 a.m. at the community center, and I’ll keep you in the loop if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it, Sam — I’ll pass it along and keep it simple. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Ira — appreciate it. I’ll let you know if I hear anything on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Bo — I’ll do the same and let you know if I hear anything out and about.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Ira — appreciate it. Just keep me posted if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a few tools and help however I can—do we know what the repair drive needs most?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — tools are perfect. We need hands for setup, sorting the list, and greeting folks at the community center Sunday at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet — I’ll be there Sunday at 9 and can help with setup, sorting, and greeting. I’ll bring a few tools too, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it’s still happening, and I’m keeping an eye on the details. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara — after 3:30 still works best for me. Just let me know the time and place when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it — after 3:30 works, and I’ll let you know the time and place as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still don’t have the repair drive details in front of me, but I can help piece them together from what we know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal — I’ve got the supply list ready, so I can fill in the repair drive details. Just tell me what you’ve got, and I’ll note what still needs picking up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — I only know I still don’t have the full repair drive details in front of me, but I can help track what’s missing if you share the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can spread the word and I’ll bring any tools or spare parts I have.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — after 3:30 works best for me too. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: How about 4:00 PM? I’ll bring my tools and a few spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure thing — just send me the repair drive plan and pickup spots, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and send over the repair drive plan and pickup spots as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll wait for the plan and pickup spots, then I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep things simple today—just tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’ll bring the cordless drill, the spare screws, and a box for the small parts.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good, Noah — thank you. I can take sign-in and help point people where to go.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Rosa — are you still collecting items for the repair drive, or has everything already been sorted?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — we’re still collecting a few items, and I’ve got the updated list lined up. We’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, so I can make sure everything’s ready there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what items do you still need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I still don’t have the full details, Nell, but I can help piece them together if you want. Once I know where they’re collecting things, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus—that’d help a lot. Just let me know where they’re collecting things and what I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m still checking on the collection spot, Nell, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it. For now, just have any tools or repair supplies handy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: A cordless drill and any spare screws would help a lot. If you’ve got some time, you could also bring a box for sorting the small parts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can bring a cordless drill, spare screws, and a box for sorting the small parts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s perfect, Sam — thank you. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I was just saying I’ll be at the community center at 9 a.m. to help with setup, and I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I’ll help line up the volunteers and keep track of the tools. Do you need anything else before 9 a.m.?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m sending the plan and pickup spots shortly, and I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara — that’s perfect. I’ll keep sharing the plan and remind folks to meet at the community center at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Quinn — I’ll keep folks updated and make sure the pickup spots go out soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: If it’s after 3:30, I can come help — but do we know what supplies we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Pia — I’m not totally sure yet, but I’ll check what’s still missing and let you know. If you can come after 3:30, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — once you know what’s missing, let me know and I can help figure it out. I’m good after 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you confirm which items are still needed and where they should be dropped off? I want to make sure I’ve got the repair drive details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still checking the latest list, but I can ask around and confirm what’s needed and the drop-off spot for you. If you want, I can also keep track of who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please — that would be really helpful. Let me know the confirmed items and drop-off spot when you have them, and I can help keep it organized.
